name: StopForumSpam API (api.stopforumspam.org)
tier_rationale: Long-running community anti-spam project with an identifiable operator, public API documentation and usage terms (A8 community); P164 final condition 2: 'Registry provider stopforumspam: tier community'.

reliability.justification: Forum-spam reports submitted by forum operators; shared/NAT addresses and test addresses (test@example.com is listed) are common false positives, so the signal is capped at severity low and never counted in consensus (P164 cond 3-4).

api.title: StopForumSpam api?json with ip, emailhash (MD5 of the normalised address; never the plaintext e-mail) and username (registration-abuse cases only); add.php submissions are never built

terms.quote: Terms: Your use of this data and supporting software is non-commercial. (usage page, 2026-11-26) - P164 cond 2 (binding council text): StopForumSpam's terms are non-commercial but let 'any commercial system' use the data for internal use only, with no resale (verified 2026-11-26): terms 'noncommercial'; off under the corporate profile until licence-cleared (legal records a licence_allow entry with scope 'internal use only, no resale').

api.notes: Research C0368 (verified live 2026-11-26). A request without fields answers HTTP 503 {"success":0,"error":[{"message":"request not understood"}]}; json answers get a 503 when the query rate is exceeded (usage page); an invalid value gives a per-field error inside success 1 (never 'not listed'). frequency 255 is a blacklist/wildcard rule or a Tor exit, not 255 reports. 'API queries are limited to 100,000 per day' (usage page): the P334 budget is 5,000/day (safety margin 0.05) for a low-weight signal. Never counted in CR27 consensus (P164 cond 4).
api.licensed_alternative: A licence_allow entry recorded by legal for stopforumspam.api with scope 'internal use only, no resale' (P164 cond 2).

notes: Owned by batch p3-G07-1 (P164, module threat_intel_ioc/stopforumspam). BotScout (botscout.com) is not in this build (P164 cond 1: low precision, small operator) and has no provider entry. personal_data_review stays null until legal records the review: e-mail hashes and usernames are then sent only when the module is selected explicitly with a recorded purpose (A3 BR8, POL-07). The web host www.stopforumspam.com is listed for the manual IP-check link of pack threat_intel_g07_p3 only: V3LUM never requests it (add.php submissions are never built).
